turns:
Implement a pure function `slugify(text: str) -> str` for URL slugs.
Requirements:
1. Lowercase the input.
2. Replace runs of whitespace with a single hyphen.
3. Remove characters that are not lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens.
4. Collapse consecutive hyphens into one and strip leading/trailing hyphens.
5. Truncate to at most 60 characters, then strip any trailing hyphen left by the truncation.
6. The function must be pure (no printing, no file I/O, no globals) and include a docstring with at least one doctest example.
